_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Whether or not to include jetski skins unlocked via codes found in other VRChat worlds to the pool as filler items.
This option assumes you have already found and used the codes to unlock all 6 of these skins.
Whether or not to include locations for harder time trial times on each track.
These will logically expect you to have received both Progressive Speed Upgrades before you can achieve them.
How many tracks must be completed in order to complete the game.
